items.exampleEn: I am sick today, so I will stay home.
items.exampleZh: 我今天生病了，所以會待在家。

items.exampleEn: I am very tired after work.
It is hard to breathe in this room.
items.exampleZh: 在這個房間裡很難呼吸。

items.exampleEn: There is smoke in the kitchen!

items.sentenceEn: I brush my teeth after every meal.

items.audioEn: I have a fever, so I can't go to work today.
items.audioZh: 我發燒了，所以今天沒辦法去上班。

items.sentenceEn: The nurse helps the sick children.
The smoke makes it hard to breathe.

items.stemEn: I worked for ten hours. I am very ____.
items.stemZh: 我工作了十個小時，非常累。

items.stemEn: Please open the window. I can't ____.
items.stemZh: 請開一下窗戶，我沒辦法呼吸。

items.passageEn: Leo is sick today. He has a fever, and it is hard for him to breathe. His mother takes him to the hospital. A nurse gives him some water. Leo's father smokes at home, and now he wants to stop smoking.
items.passageZh: Leo 今天生病了。他發燒，而且呼吸困難。他媽媽帶他去醫院。一位護士給他一些水。Leo 的爸爸會在家抽菸，現在他想戒菸了。

questions.questionZh: Leo 的爸爸現在想做什麼？

referenceEn: I am very tired today. I want to go to bed early.
I'm tired today, so I want to sleep early.
rubricZh: 「很累」例如 I am very tired；用 feel tired 也正確
「早點睡」可用 go to bed early、sleep early 等

items.instructionZh: 用 sick 造一個句子，說說你生病時會做什麼。
referenceEn: When I am sick, I stay in bed.
I drink a lot of water when I am sick.
rubricZh: 「生病時」可用 when I am sick、when I feel sick、when I get sick 等
sick 是形容詞，放在 be 動詞、feel、get 等後面（例如 am sick、feel sick、get sick）
